repos_data.description: Simply ACID* key-value database. At the medium or even low latency it tries to provide greater throughput without losing the ACID properties of the database. The database provides the ability to create record headers at own discretion and use them as transactions. The maximum size of stored data is limited by the size of the computer's RAM.
Model Context Protocol server for interacting with iaptic
Correctly rounded monetary amounts and exchange rates for Go
